display.purpose: Large Korean hero headlines and policy page titles.

body.purpose: Mail metadata, explanatory copy, controls, and legal reading.

shadows.name: shell-medium
shadows.purpose: Web mail shell and featured pricing surface.

motion.name: long-press-fill
motion.purpose: Progress cue before the mobile context menu opens.

components.name: Navigation pill
components.description: Sticky translucent capsule framing product navigation.
components.css: .gnb { position: sticky; top: 12px; padding: 9px 10px 9px 20px; border: 1px solid #dce7d7; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.78); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(24,53,31,.05); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); } .gnb a:hover { background: #dcefd5; color: #285c31; }

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Short, high-confidence action for pricing and connection flows.
components.css: .pricing-cta { display: block; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: #285c31; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .pricing-card--featured .pricing-cta { background: #1f4a28; }

components.name: Mail row
components.description: Scannable message row with a low-contrast tint and explicit selected state.
components.css: .message-row { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 5px; margin-top: 9px; padding: 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #f2f7ef; color: #18351f; text-align: left; } .message-row[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #dcefd5; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #4d8c4a; }

components.name: Destructive dialog
components.description: Final confirmation before an irreversible mail deletion.
components.css: dialog { width: calc(100% - 40px); max-width: 420px; padding: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(20,45,24,.22); } dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(14,30,17,.5); }

narrative.overview: 싹메일은 잎빛 배경, 짙은 녹색 잉크, 반투명 흰색 표면, Figtree 타이포그래피로 메일 정리 작업을 차분하게 만든다. 넓은 웹 히어로와 2열 작업면은 모바일의 단일 열 흐름으로 접히며, 캡슐 내비게이션과 부드러운 카드가 제품 전반의 연결 조직이다.

rules.name: The One Green Voice Rule
rules.body: 일반 상호작용과 선택 상태에는 Forest Brand 계열만 사용하고, 빨강·노랑은 의미 있는 상태에만 사용한다.

rules.name: The Tinted Depth Rule
rules.body: 검은 단일 그림자 대신 녹색 계열의 낮은 불투명도와 레이어된 깊이를 사용한다.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: 제목·본문·컨트롤은 Figtree와 기존 fallback 순서를 공유한다.

dos: Do reuse --ssak-* and Astryx theme tokens before adding values.
Do preserve the web two-column and mobile one-column mail flow.
Do pair status color with text, labels, or controls.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for custom transitions.
donts: Don't add rainbow status colors, emoji icons, or pure black text.
Don't mix sharp cards with the existing capsule and rounded-card language.
Don't turn recommendation or auto-organization into automatic permanent deletion.
Don't invent customer proof, pricing claims, or legal guarantees.
